description: This file defines the 'Criteria' class, a model object used for specifying search or query parameters, including start index, maximum count, code, and ordering.

classes.name: Criteria
classes.description: A class representing search criteria with pagination and ordering options.

methods.name: getMaxCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of results to return.

methods.name: setMaxCount
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of results to return.

methods.name: getStartIndex
methods.description: Returns the starting index for the search results.

methods.name: setStartIndex
methods.description: Sets the starting index for the search results.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code associated with this criteria.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code associated with this criteria.

methods.name: setOrderBy
methods.description: Sets the ordering direction, e.g., ascending or descending.
